checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.why: Frames are 496x826 portrait, full-bleed artwork, no bars. The 8 s length is not directly verifiable.

must.item: Soft blue and purple glowing ribbons visibly move slowly on dark background
must.why: Blue/purple glowing ribbon on black. The motion looks fairly large between frames, though; the 3.2 s frame shows a big change.

must.item: Top third mostly dark throughout, brightest ribbons lower
must.why: At 3.2 s the ribbon rises to the top, with a curled head at about y=130-240, inside the top third. That clashes with the clock area.

must.item: No visible jump at loop boundary
must.why: The 7.6 s frame closely matches the first-frame still, so the loop point looks continuous. This was not tested in playback.

must.item: No words, clock graphics or UI baked in
must.why: No text or interface elements in any frame.
Audio cannot be checked from still frames. The assistant claims the video is silent.

faults.what: Around the middle of the clip the ribbon rises into the top third as a thick tube with a curled end. This breaks the 'top third dark for the clock' requirement.

The motion is not slow or gentle. The shape changes a lot, from a flat wave to a vertical tube and back. The ribbon looks like a thick, tube-like blob rather than soft ribbons. Only a single ribbon is present.

summary: The wallpaper is a good-looking, loop-consistent blue and purple glowing ribbon on black. Mid-clip, the ribbon swings up into the top third, which breaks the dark clock area requirement, and the motion is more dramatic than slow.
